title: Field Gauge Noise — Meter 412 Maple Street

fields.organization: Corwin Valley Gas Company — Measurement and Regulation
fields.location: 412 Maple Street, Downtown Corwin, Pressure District 7
fields.summary: A customer at 412 Maple Street reported a gas meter reading of 14.3 in. w.c. and a persistent electronic hum from the meter box. The meter is an older, non-SCADA-connected unit installed in 2002. No field gauge log or SCADA tag includes this location. The customer was instructed to call 911 if gas odor is detected. No active pressure issue confirmed in the district.

findings.notes: Meter box accessible, no visible damage, housing intact
Meter not registered in SCADA or pressure verification chain
No field gauge log includes this address
No odor detected at site
Meter not part of pressure verification chain; no upstream or downstream data link
2002 model, not in SCADA telemetry list
Hum confirmed by technician; likely internal meter component failure
Customer advised to call 911 if odor is detected and to avoid ignition sources
No evidence of tampering or leak at meter seal
District pressure confirmed at 0 in. w.c. on SCADA and field gauges at RS-21 and RS-22

actionsTaken: Confirmed customer report via phone at 19:13
Notified Control Room via radio: 'FOS to GCM, noise report from 412 Maple Street, meter hum only, no pressure issue'
recommendations: Log as noise item in EOP 4.3 incident log
No field action required on meter
Continue focus on district overpressure resolution
fields.photosNote: 1 photo attached: IMG_1024-1915-0047 (meter box, visible hum, no leak)

instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should triage it down without engaging. The meter is not part of the pressure verification chain.
